skills.name: Image Watermark
skills.description: Batch-add logo or text watermarks to image folders without overwriting source files.
skills.description_zh: 批量读取图片并添加 Logo、文字水印或版权信息，默认不覆盖源文件。

skills.name: Video Bilingual Subtitles
skills.description: Transcribe video or audio, translate captions, align timestamps, and export SRT/ASS or hardcoded video.
skills.description_zh: 完成音轨提取、转写、翻译、时间轴校准和字幕渲染，可输出 SRT、ASS 或硬字幕视频。

skills.name: URL to Short Video
skills.description: Turn a product or article URL into a short-video production package with script, shot list, narration, assets, and render candidates.
skills.description_zh: 读取产品或文章网页，生成脚本、分镜、配音、素材清单和成片候选；最终视觉质量需人工审阅。

skills.name: Social Image Batch
skills.description: Generate batches of social visuals from a brief while keeping naming, aspect ratio, and manifest metadata consistent.
skills.description_zh: 根据内容 Brief 批量生成社交媒体配图，并统一比例、命名和任务清单。

skills.name: Long Video to Clip Candidates
skills.description: Analyze long-form video and produce short clip candidates based on topic boundaries, semantic density, and pacing.
skills.description_zh: 分析长视频中的话题、语义密度和节奏，输出短视频候选片段，而非承诺预测爆款。

skills.name: Podcast Digest
skills.description: Process RSS feeds, episode URLs, or local audio into transcripts, chapters, summaries, key ideas, and references.
skills.description_zh: 把 RSS、单集链接或本地音频转换成文字稿、章节、摘要、核心观点和引用信息。

skills.name: Social Carousel
skills.description: Convert long-form content into structured carousel slides for Xiaohongshu, LinkedIn, or Instagram with template-based rendering.
skills.description_zh: 将文章或视频文字稿拆成封面、Hook、内容卡片和 CTA，并通过模板稳定渲染。
skills.core_stack: LLM / HTML or Canvas renderer / optional image API

skills.name: Thumbnail Generator
skills.description: Generate multiple thumbnail concepts and render candidates from title plus content context; does not guarantee CTR.
skills.description_zh: 根据标题和内容上下文生成多套封面概念与候选图，不承诺点击率结果。

skills.name: Meme GIF Generator
skills.description: Generate meme or GIF concepts and production assets from a topic, event, or reaction brief.
skills.description_zh: 围绕话题、事件或情绪生成 Meme/GIF 创意和制作素材，创意质量需人工筛选。

skills.name: Voice Generator
skills.description: Turn scripts into controlled speech with pacing, pause, and style settings using an authorized TTS provider.
skills.description_zh: 通过合法授权的 TTS 服务把脚本转成可控语速、停顿和风格的配音。

skills.name: Slides to Video
skills.description: Turn slides into narrated training or explainer videos with page timing and basic transitions.
skills.description_zh: 把 PPT/PDF 逐页生成旁白、配音、页面时长和基础转场；不承诺自动生成专业级复杂动画。

skills.name: Auto BGM
skills.description: Analyze scene and pacing to suggest or place background music and apply ducking; music selection remains subjective.
skills.description_zh: 分析视频情绪和节奏，生成或匹配背景音乐并进行 Ducking；选曲质量仍具有主观性和版权约束。

skills.name: Live Teleprompter
skills.description: Track live speech against an outline and surface the next talking point through a low-latency streaming application.
skills.description_zh: 实时监听讲话并根据提纲判断进度、提示下一段内容；需要流式音频和低延迟 UI，不是纯一次性 Skill。

skills.name: Article to Video
skills.description: Convert an article into a script, storyboard, voice track, asset plan, and render candidates.
skills.description_zh: 把文章转换为脚本、分镜、配音和素材计划，并生成成片候选；最终剪辑质量需人工确认。

skills.name: Recording to Content
skills.description: Repurpose a recording into transcript, article, newsletter, social posts, and short-video scripts.
skills.description_zh: 把一段录音同时转成文字稿、文章、Newsletter、社媒内容和短视频脚本。

skills.name: Smart File Organizer
skills.description: Classify and reorganize local files by content, project, date, and type with dry-run enabled by default.
skills.description_zh: 按照内容、项目、日期和文件类型整理本地文件，默认先 Dry Run，禁止静默删除。

skills.name: Personalized Mail Merge
skills.description: Generate personalized outreach drafts from a spreadsheet and optionally send them after human approval.
skills.description_zh: 根据表格联系人信息批量生成差异化邮件草稿；真正发送需要邮箱授权并默认人工批准。

skills.name: Document Translator
skills.description: Translate DOCX, PPTX, and supported PDFs while preserving structure where practical; layout fidelity varies by format.
skills.description_zh: 翻译 DOCX、PPTX 和可处理的 PDF，并尽量保留结构；复杂 PDF 的原排版无法保证百分百恢复。

skills.name: Meeting Minutes
skills.description: Turn meeting audio or transcripts into decisions, action items, owners, deadlines, and unresolved questions.
skills.description_zh: 把会议录音或文字稿整理成结论、待办、负责人、Deadline 和未决问题；不得编造会议中未明确的信息。

skills.name: Chat to Todo
skills.description: Extract actionable commitments from chat and create tasks in connected work-management systems.
skills.description_zh: 从聊天内容识别真实任务并写入已连接的 Notion、Linear、Todoist、Asana 等系统。

skills.name: Inbox Triage
skills.description: Classify unread email by urgency and actionability, summarize threads, and create reply drafts without sending by default.
skills.description_zh: 对未读邮件进行优先级分类、线程摘要和回复草稿生成，默认不自动发送。

skills.name: Survey Builder
skills.description: Turn a research objective into survey questions, logic, form schema, and downstream analysis workflow.
skills.description_zh: 把调研目标转换成问题、跳转逻辑、表单结构和结果分析流程；自动创建在线表单需要外部平台连接。

skills.name: Calendar Coordinator
skills.description: Find mutually available meeting windows across calendars and propose or create events after confirmation.
skills.description_zh: 读取参与者日历和时区，寻找共同空档；写入日历前要求确认。

skills.name: Weekly Report
skills.description: Collect metrics from connected sources and produce a structured weekly report with changes, explanations, risks, and next actions.
skills.description_zh: 从已连接的数据源收集指标，生成变化、原因、风险和下一步行动组成的周报。

skills.name: Expense Parser
skills.description: Extract merchant, date, amount, tax, and category from receipts and map them to an expense schema.
skills.description_zh: 识别发票和收据中的商户、日期、金额、税额和类别，并映射到报销字段；正式提交需按企业规则配置。

skills.name: SOP Generator
skills.description: Convert screen recordings, transcripts, or operation notes into a step-by-step SOP with screenshots and validation checkpoints.
skills.description_zh: 把录屏、文字稿或操作记录整理成带截图和验证点的 SOP；仅凭录屏可能漏掉不可见操作。

skills.name: Employee Onboarding
skills.description: Generate role-specific onboarding packs and optionally orchestrate account or task setup through connected systems.
skills.description_zh: 根据岗位生成新人资料包、培训和 30/60/90 计划；创建账号和权限需 HR/IT 系统连接。

skills.name: Contract Signing Workflow
skills.description: Track contract status, route documents, and send reminders while keeping legal judgment and final signing under human control.
skills.description_zh: 负责合同状态、流转和催签；法律判断、最终发送与签署必须保留人工控制。

skills.name: Invoice Data Extractor
skills.description: Batch-extract structured fields from invoices, receipts, screenshots, or PDFs and export validated JSON, CSV, or Excel.
skills.description_zh: 批量提取发票、收据、截图或 PDF 的商户、日期、金额、税额、币种和明细，输出经过校验的结构化数据。

skills.name: Web Data Extractor
skills.description: Extract public or authorized website data into a declared schema using browser automation while respecting access controls and site policies.
skills.description_zh: 通过浏览器自动化把公开或已授权网页提取成指定 Schema；需遵守登录权限、反爬限制和站点规则。

skills.name: Sales Forecast
skills.description: Build reproducible forecasts from historical sales with baseline comparison, seasonality analysis, and confidence intervals.
skills.description_zh: 基于历史销售数据建立可复现预测，包含基线比较、季节性和置信区间；数据不足时必须明确不确定性。

skills.name: Spreadsheet Merge
skills.description: Map semantically equivalent columns across spreadsheets, merge datasets, detect duplicates, and report conflicts without silently dropping rows.
skills.description_zh: 识别多个表格中语义相同的字段，合并、去重并报告冲突，禁止静默丢行。

skills.name: Spreadsheet Dashboard
skills.description: Analyze spreadsheet schemas, propose KPIs, generate charts, and build a reproducible dashboard or report.
skills.description_zh: 分析 Excel/CSV 的字段和指标，建议 KPI、生成图表和可复现 Dashboard；业务 KPI 最好由用户确认。

skills.name: Trend Research Agent
skills.description: Collect dated public signals across search, news, products, repositories, and social sources and produce a sourced trend report.
skills.description_zh: 跨搜索、新闻、产品、代码仓库和社交来源收集带日期的公开信号，生成可追溯趋势报告。

skills.name: Sentiment Analysis
skills.description: Classify sentiment and cluster recurring topics, pain points, feature requests, and customer insights from text datasets.
skills.description_zh: 对评论、客服、问卷等文本进行情绪分类和主题聚类，识别痛点、需求和用户洞察。

skills.name: Data Anomaly Monitor
skills.description: Monitor metrics over time, detect statistically unusual changes, and use AI to explain likely context without replacing deterministic detection.
skills.description_zh: 持续监控指标并使用统计方法识别异常，AI 负责解释上下文而不是替代确定性检测。

skills.name: Document Diff
skills.description: Compare two versions of a document and identify additions, deletions, numeric changes, and semantic clause changes.
skills.description_zh: 比较两版 PDF/DOCX 的新增、删除、数字和语义条款变化；扫描 PDF 可结合 OCR。
skills.core_stack: Document parser / OCR optional / diff / LLM

skills.name: Data Cleaner
skills.description: Profile datasets, propose a cleaning plan, standardize formats, detect duplicates and outliers, and preserve an audit trail.
skills.description_zh: 检查缺失值、重复、格式、类别和异常值，先生成清洗计划再执行，并保留审计记录和原文件。

skills.name: Log Analyzer
skills.description: Cluster application or infrastructure logs, build an incident timeline, and produce root-cause candidates with evidence.
skills.description_zh: 聚类应用或基础设施日志、建立时间线，并基于证据给出根因候选和修复建议。

skills.name: Figma to Frontend
skills.description: Use authorized Figma design context to generate component structure, assets, responsive layouts, and frontend code with visual validation.
skills.description_zh: 通过授权的 Figma 设计上下文生成组件结构、资产、响应式布局和前端代码，并进行视觉验证。

skills.name: Code Refactor
skills.description: Analyze a repository, create an incremental refactor plan, modify code in small steps, and validate each step with tests.
skills.description_zh: 分析代码仓库，先制定增量重构计划，再小步修改并通过测试验证。

skills.name: Framework Migration
skills.description: Plan and execute incremental framework, language, SDK, or architecture migrations with dependency audits and validation.
skills.description_zh: 规划并分阶段执行框架、语言、SDK 或架构迁移，包含依赖审计和验证。

skills.name: Repository Documentation
skills.description: Scan a repository and generate or update README, architecture, setup, environment, API, deployment, and troubleshooting docs.
skills.description_zh: 扫描代码仓库并生成或更新 README、架构、安装、环境变量、API、部署和排障文档。

skills.name: Pull Request Review
skills.description: Review diffs for correctness, security, performance, maintainability, tests, and breaking changes while prioritizing actionable findings.
skills.description_zh: 审查 PR 的正确性、安全、性能、可维护性、测试和破坏性变化，并优先报告真正可执行的问题。

skills.name: API Generator
skills.description: Turn requirements into API schemas, routes, validation, authentication scaffolding, OpenAPI documentation, and tests.
skills.description_zh: 把需求转换成数据模型、路由、校验、认证脚手架、OpenAPI 文档和测试；生产安全配置需额外审查。

skills.name: Debug Agent
skills.description: Reproduce failures, trace relevant code paths, isolate root causes, apply minimal patches, and run validation tests.
skills.description_zh: 从复现问题开始，追踪相关代码，定位根因，最小修改并运行测试验证。

skills.name: Unit Test Generator
skills.description: Generate behavior-focused tests for normal, edge, invalid, and regression cases, then run them and report coverage gaps.
skills.description_zh: 针对正常、边界、非法输入和回归场景生成测试，并执行测试、报告覆盖缺口。

skills.name: Cron Builder
skills.description: Convert scheduling requirements into cron or scheduler configuration, validate timing, and generate safe executable wrappers.
skills.description_zh: 把自然语言时间需求转换成 Cron 或调度配置，校验时区和频率，并生成安全执行脚本。

skills.name: Image Upscaler
skills.description: Upscale and enhance low-resolution images using a configured local or API model, with a mode that avoids generative detail invention.
skills.description_zh: 使用配置好的本地或云端超分模型增强低分辨率图片，并提供尽量避免生成不存在细节的保守模式。

skills.name: Background Remover
skills.description: Segment image subjects, refine masks, export transparent PNGs, and optionally composite approved replacement backgrounds.
skills.description_zh: 识别主体、优化边缘、输出透明 PNG，并可组合用户批准的新背景。

skills.name: Brand Kit Generator
skills.description: Generate brand identity directions, palettes, typography proposals, tokens, and example applications from a brand brief; not a substitute for brand strategy research.
skills.description_zh: 根据品牌 Brief 生成视觉方向、配色、字体、Token 和应用示例；不能替代完整品牌战略和用户研究。
skills.core_stack: LLM / image generation optional / design tokens

skills.name: Landing Page Builder
skills.description: Turn a product brief into information architecture, copy, responsive UI, frontend code, QA, and optionally deployment through connected infrastructure.
skills.description_zh: 把产品说明转换成信息架构、文案、响应式 UI、前端代码和 QA，并可通过已连接基础设施部署。

skills.name: Sketch to UI
skills.description: Interpret sketches or wireframes into structured high-fidelity UI while explicitly flagging missing interaction requirements.
skills.description_zh: 把草图或 Wireframe 转换成高保真 UI，并明确标出原图无法推断的交互需求。

skills.name: SVG Icon Generator
skills.description: Generate a consistent SVG icon set and normalize paths, viewBox, stroke, naming, and output validity.
skills.description_zh: 生成统一风格 SVG 图标集，并规范路径、ViewBox、Stroke、命名和文件合法性。

skills.name: Product Mockup Generator
skills.description: Generate product presentation mockups from approved source assets, favoring deterministic templates when exact geometry or text fidelity matters.
skills.description_zh: 根据产品素材生成展示 Mockup；对精确几何、Logo 和文字要求高时优先模板而非纯生成图。
skills.core_stack: Image tools / mockup templates / optional image API

skills.name: Palette Extractor
skills.description: Extract dominant colors and map them into semantic design tokens such as primary, surface, text, border, and accent.
skills.description_zh: 从参考图提取主要颜色并映射成 Primary、Surface、Text、Border、Accent 等语义色。

skills.name: Multi-platform Resize
skills.description: Adapt a master creative into multiple aspect ratios using subject and safe-area detection; generated recomposition or outpainting requires review.
skills.description_zh: 根据主体和安全区检测把主视觉适配多种比例；涉及重构图或扩图时需人工复核。
skills.core_stack: ImageMagick/Pillow / optional vision or generative model

skills.name: Font Pairing
skills.description: Recommend typography systems based on brand tone, language coverage, platform use, and license constraints.
skills.description_zh: 根据品牌气质、语言覆盖、使用场景和字体授权约束推荐字体系统。

skills.name: Pricing Analysis
skills.description: Model pricing scenarios from costs, margin targets, customer segments, and competitor inputs without claiming a single objectively optimal price.
skills.description_zh: 根据成本、毛利目标、用户分层和竞品输入模拟价格方案，不声称存在唯一“最佳价格”。

skills.name: Competitor Monitor
skills.description: Monitor authorized public competitor sources, detect meaningful changes, and generate dated intelligence digests.
skills.description_zh: 监控允许访问的竞争对手公开来源，检测真正变化并生成带日期的情报摘要。

skills.name: Earnings Analyzer
skills.description: Extract period-aware financial metrics, guidance, risk factors, and management commentary with source traceability.
skills.description_zh: 从财报和 Earnings Call 提取带期间和单位的财务指标、指引、风险和管理层观点，并保持来源可追溯。

skills.name: Lead Follow-up
skills.description: Research CRM leads from authorized sources and generate personalized follow-up drafts; sending remains approval-gated.
skills.description_zh: 读取 CRM 线索和授权公开资料，生成个性化跟进草稿；发送动作默认需要批准。

skills.name: Invoice Generator
skills.description: Generate invoices from order or contract data, validate required fields, and render PDF or structured output; jurisdictional compliance is configurable.
skills.description_zh: 根据订单或合同数据生成发票、检查必填字段并输出 PDF/结构化数据；各地区合规要求需单独配置。

skills.name: Strategy Backtest
skills.description: Convert explicit trading rules into historical backtests with fees, slippage, and bias checks; never execute live trades by default.
skills.description_zh: 把明确交易规则转换为历史回测，纳入手续费、滑点和偏差检查；默认绝不执行真实交易。

skills.name: Market Technical Analysis
skills.description: Calculate technical indicators and describe observed market conditions without presenting guaranteed buy or sell outcomes.
skills.description_zh: 计算技术指标并描述当前市场状态，不输出保证性买卖结论。

skills.name: Budget Analyzer
skills.description: Classify transaction data and analyze recurring spend, income, cash flow, subscriptions, and budget variance.
skills.description_zh: 分类流水并分析固定支出、收入、现金流、订阅和预算偏差；接入真实账户时需严格权限控制。

skills.name: Portfolio Analyzer
skills.description: Calculate portfolio return, volatility, concentration, allocation, exposure, and correlation from provided holdings and market data.
skills.description_zh: 根据持仓和市场数据计算收益、波动、集中度、配置、风险暴露和相关性。

skills.name: Knowledge Base Builder
skills.description: Transform documentation into chunked, metadata-rich, searchable knowledge-base assets and evaluate retrieval quality.
skills.description_zh: 把文档转换成带 Chunk、Metadata 和索引的可搜索知识库，并评估检索质量。

skills.name: Conversation Action Items
skills.description: Extract explicit commitments, tasks, owners, deadlines, and context from chat or meeting transcripts.
skills.description_zh: 从聊天或会议中提取明确承诺、任务、负责人、截止日期和上下文，避免凭空猜测。

skills.name: Personalized Greetings
skills.description: Generate personalized greeting drafts from user-provided relationship and context data without inventing private facts.
skills.description_zh: 根据用户提供的关系和背景生成个性化祝福草稿，不编造私人信息。

skills.name: Press Release Generator
skills.description: Turn verified event facts into a structured press-release draft and produce a fact-check checklist.
skills.description_zh: 把已核实事件信息整理成结构完整的新闻稿初稿，并生成事实核查 Checklist。

skills.name: Reply Assistant
skills.description: Analyze message context and generate multiple reply options with distinct tone and intent while preserving known facts.
skills.description_zh: 分析消息上下文并生成不同语气与目的的回复选项，同时保持事实一致。

skills.name: Pitch Generator
skills.description: Generate audience-specific 30-second, 1-minute, and 3-minute pitches from product and evidence inputs.
skills.description_zh: 根据产品、受众和证据输入生成 30 秒、1 分钟和 3 分钟 Pitch。

skills.name: Social FAQ Reply
skills.name_zh: 社交媒体 FAQ 回复
skills.description: Classify incoming social questions, draft approved FAQ answers, and escalate sensitive cases before any external reply action.
skills.description_zh: 识别私信和评论中的 FAQ，生成批准范围内的回复草稿；退款、投诉等敏感情况升级人工。
search_keywords: 社交媒体 FAQ 回复

skills.name: Speech Writer
skills.description: Turn structured ideas into speeches with narrative flow, timing, emphasis, and delivery notes.
skills.description_zh: 把要点转换成具有叙事结构的演讲稿，并加入时长、停顿、强调和演讲提示。

skills.name: Decision Matrix
skills.description: Build weighted decision matrices, calculate scores deterministically, and run sensitivity analysis over user-defined criteria.
skills.description_zh: 根据用户定义的维度和权重建立决策矩阵，以确定性方式计算分数并做敏感性分析。

skills.name: Trip Planner
skills.description: Build practical itineraries from destination, time, budget, transport, and preferences using fresh location and availability data when connected.
skills.description_zh: 根据目的地、时间、预算、交通和偏好生成实际行程；高质量结果应连接最新地点、营业时间和交通信息。

skills.name: Gift Recommender
skills.description: Recommend gift categories or products from relationship, interests, occasion, budget, and live availability when connected.
skills.description_zh: 根据关系、兴趣、场景和预算推荐礼物；具体商品质量依赖地区、库存和实时价格。

skills.name: Resume Builder
skills.description: Create master, targeted, ATS-oriented, bilingual resume variants strictly from verified user experience without fabricating achievements.
skills.description_zh: 基于已核实经历生成 Master、岗位定制、ATS 和中英双语简历，严禁编造成就或数字。

skills.name: Meal Planner
skills.description: Generate weekly meal plans and shopping lists from stated dietary preferences, time, and budget; not a substitute for medical nutrition advice.
skills.description_zh: 根据饮食偏好、时间和预算生成每周菜单与购物清单；不替代医学营养建议。

skills.name: Conditional Reminder
skills.description: Create reminders that depend on future conditions or external events using a scheduler plus the relevant data source or webhook.
skills.description_zh: 使用调度器和对应数据源/Webhook 创建由未来条件触发的提醒，而不只是固定时间提醒。

skills.name: Habit Planner
skills.description: Break a goal into minimum repeatable actions, schedule review cycles, and produce a lightweight tracking plan.
skills.description_zh: 把目标拆成最小可执行动作、复盘周期和轻量追踪计划。

skills.name: Read Later Digest
skills.description: Collect saved URLs, extract readable content, rank relevance, and produce scheduled daily or weekly digests.
skills.description_zh: 读取保存的网页链接，提取正文、排序重要性并生成每日或每周摘要。

skills.name: Git Deploy
skills.description: Orchestrate build, test, artifact creation, approval, and deployment after repository changes; production deployment is approval-gated.
skills.description_zh: 在代码变更后编排 Build、Test、Artifact、Approval 和 Deploy；生产部署默认需要批准。

skills.name: Backup Manager
skills.description: Design and run full or incremental backups with encryption, retention, integrity checks, and restore verification.
skills.description_zh: 设计并执行完整或增量备份，包含加密、保留策略、完整性检查和恢复验证。

skills.name: SSL Manager
skills.description: Check certificate status, automate issuance or renewal with established tooling, deploy changes, and verify service health.
skills.description_zh: 检查证书状态，调用成熟工具申请/续签并部署证书，最后验证服务健康。

skills.name: Service Monitor
skills.description: Deploy or configure health checks for endpoints, processes, ports, and resource metrics and route alerts to configured channels.
skills.description_zh: 配置网站、API、进程、端口和资源指标健康检查，并把异常发送到指定通知渠道。

skills.name: Server Security Audit
skills.description: Audit authorized servers using established scanners and configuration checks, then summarize findings and remediation steps.
skills.description_zh: 在明确授权的服务器上调用成熟扫描和配置检查工具，并汇总问题与修复建议。

skills.name: Docker Generator
skills.description: Analyze an application, generate Dockerfile and Compose configuration, build images, and validate runtime behavior.
skills.description_zh: 分析项目运行环境，生成 Dockerfile/Compose，并实际 Build 和运行验证。

skills.name: Secret Scanner
skills.description: Scan repositories and history with dedicated secret-detection tools and produce remediation guidance without exposing secrets in reports.
skills.description_zh: 使用专用密钥扫描工具检查仓库和 Git 历史，并生成修复建议，报告中不回显完整密钥。

skills.name: Paper Summarizer
skills.description: Summarize academic papers into research question, method, dataset, findings, contributions, limitations, and open questions.
skills.description_zh: 把论文整理成研究问题、方法、数据、结果、创新、局限和开放问题。

skills.name: Flashcard Generator
skills.description: Convert notes or source material into concise spaced-repetition cards and export compatible CSV or structured formats.
skills.description_zh: 把笔记或学习材料转换成适合间隔重复的卡片，并输出 Anki 兼容 CSV 或结构化格式。

skills.name: Study Plan
skills.description: Create adaptive study schedules from target, deadline, current level, available time, and spaced-review requirements.
skills.description_zh: 根据目标、截止日期、当前水平、可用时间和复习周期生成可执行学习计划。

skills.name: Plain Language Explainer
skills.description: Explain difficult technical or academic material at a requested level using analogies, definitions, and worked examples.
skills.description_zh: 按指定理解层级把复杂技术或学术材料解释清楚，并使用定义、比喻和例子。

skills.name: Mind Map Generator
skills.description: Extract concept hierarchy and relationships from long-form content and export Mermaid, Markmap, or another supported structured format.
skills.description_zh: 从长文中提取概念层级和关系，并输出 Mermaid、Markmap 等结构化思维导图格式。

skills.name: Cheatsheet Generator
skills.description: Create concise version-aware reference sheets for technical subjects, commands, APIs, or operating procedures.
skills.description_zh: 为技术主题、命令、API 或操作流程生成简洁且标明版本的一页速查表。

skills.name: Quiz Generator
skills.description: Generate assessments aligned to source material with varied difficulty, plausible distractors, verified answers, and explanations.
skills.description_zh: 根据学习材料生成不同难度的测试题、合理干扰项、经过校验的答案和解析。

skills.name: Book Knowledge Map
skills.description: Process long books chapter by chapter and build a structured map of concepts, arguments, evidence, and cross-chapter relationships.
skills.description_zh: 按章节处理长书，构建概念、论点、证据及跨章节关系的结构化知识地图。

skills.name: Pronunciation Coach
skills.description: Use a configured pronunciation-assessment engine to evaluate phonemes, stress, rhythm, fluency, and prosody and create targeted drills.
skills.description_zh: 调用配置好的发音评测引擎分析音素、重音、节奏、流利度和韵律，并生成针对性练习。

skills.name: Course Builder
skills.description: Create a curriculum package with modules, lessons, exercises, and assessments from a subject and audience brief; expert review is recommended for high-stakes instruction.
skills.description_zh: 根据主题和受众生成课程体系、模块、课时、练习和测评；高要求课程建议由领域专家复核。
